title: Minimum Stage Capacity for Conference Talks
description: An academic conference is organizing various speaker presentations. Each presentation is defined by a start time and an end time. To accommodate all talks successfully, calculate the minimum number of distinct presentation stages required so that no two talks scheduled on the same stage overlap.
input_format: A 2D array of integers representing the start and end times of all conference talks.
output_format: An integer representing the minimum number of stages needed simultaneously.

examples.explanation: Talk 1 ([0, 30]) requires stage 1. When talks [5, 10] and [15, 20] occur, a second stage is needed.
The talks do not overlap, so only 1 stage is required.
All three talks overlap with each other at some point, necessitating 3 separate stages.
